```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(nhanesA)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(readr)
```
```{r}
demo_raw <- nhanes('DEMO_D')    # demographics
huq_raw <- nhanes('HUQ_D')      # health status / access to care
bmx_raw <- nhanes('BMX_D')      # body measures
smq_raw <- nhanes('SMQ_D')      # smoking
alq_raw <- nhanes('ALQ_D')      # alcohol use
paq_raw <- nhanes('PAQ_D')      # physical activity
diq_raw <- nhanes('DIQ_D')      # diabetes
mcq_raw <- nhanes('MCQ_D')      # medical conditions
```

```{r}
# Demographic data
nhanesTableVars('DEMOGRAPHICS', 'DEMO_D')

demo <- demo_raw %>%
  select(
    "RIAGENDR",  # gender
    "RIDAGEYR",  # age in years
    "RIDRETH1",  # race/Hispanic origin
    "DMDEDUC2",  # education level
    "DMDMARTL",  # marital status
    "INDFMPIR",  # ratio of family income to poverty line
    "INDHHINC",  # total household income
    "SEQN"
  )

head(demo)
```

```{r}
# Examination data
nhanesTableVars('EXAMINATION', 'BMX_D')

bmx <- bmx_raw %>%
  select(
    "BMXWAIST",  # waist circumference (cm)
    "SEQN"
  )

head(bmx)
```

```{r}
# Health status/access to care data
nhanesTableVars('QUESTIONNAIRE', 'HUQ_D')

huq <- huq_raw %>%
  select(
    "HUQ010",  # outcome
    "SEQN"
  )

head(huq)
```

```{r}
# Physical activity data
nhanesTableVars('QUESTIONNAIRE', 'PAQ_D')

paq <- paq_raw %>%
  select(
    "PAD320",  # moderate activity
    "PAD440",  # strength activity
    "PAQ180",  # which sentence matched activity level
    "SEQN"
  )

head(paq)
```

```{r}
# Diabetes data
nhanesTableVars('QUESTIONNAIRE', 'DIQ_D')

diq <- diq_raw %>%
  select(
    "DID040",  # age of diabetes diagnosis (use as indicator)
    "SEQN"
  )

head(diq)
```

```{r}
# Medical condition data
nhanesTableVars('QUESTIONNAIRE', 'MCQ_D')

mcq <- mcq_raw %>%
  select(
    "MCQ035",   # athsma
    "MCQ092",   # blood transfusion
    "MCQ160A",  # arthritis
    "MCQ160B",  # congenetive heart failure
    "MCQ160C",  # coronary heart disease
    "MCQ160D",  # angina
    "MCQ160E",  # heart attack
    "MCQ160F",  # stroke
    "MCQ160G",  # emphysema
    "MCQ160K",  # chronic bronchitis
    "MCQ160L",  # ?
    "MCQ160M",  # thyroid problems
    "MCQ220",   # cancer
    "SEQN"
  )

head(mcq)
```

```{r}
# Put all data frames into a list
df_list <- list(demo, bmx, huq, paq, diq, mcq)

# Merge them all on SEQN ID number
full_df <- df_list %>%
  reduce(full_join, by = "SEQN")

head(full_df)
```

```{r}
# Save df to csv
write_csv(full_df, "~/stat543-fall2026/FinalProject/full_health_data.csv")
```
